CustomField.description: Start date of the service period for this line (rental or services). For Offer Types in Volume_Pricing_Catalog_Names, this drives period-based pricing: the standard UnitPrice on save is Daily_Rate__c × Service_Days__c. For other offers, this remains a billing-only field and has no effect on transport trip creation.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Service start date. Drives period-based pricing for rental and services Offer Types.
CustomField.label: Service Start Date
